notes.title: 🎉 The Music Festival DLC is Out Now! 🎶Plus a Mini Words Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/43160692fda946210ccfacf50e404c8ba30638f6.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that the [b]Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC[/b] is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. Explore themed stages, cozy camping spots, a dazzling Ferris wheel, and much more — all illustrated by Katia Numakura and set to a chill, festive soundtrack by Tatyana Jacques.

👉 Add it to your game and keep the celebration going!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802160/Meow_Moments_Music_Festival/

[h1]🎮 Mini Words Gets an Update Too![/h1]
That’s not all!
We’ve just released a new update for our word puzzle game, [b]Mini Words[/b] 🎉

🕹️ Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller
☁️ Steam Cloud Enabled – keep your progress across devices

If you enjoy relaxed logic word games, it’s a great time to check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158290/Mini_Words__minimalist_puzzle/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/828263e2b7a80914de85a50656214af06ef90ce6.png[/img]

Thank you for supporting our cozy games! We hope you enjoy this new DLC and the updates across our catalog.

notes.title: Update - Leave and come back later without worry!
notes.content:
Hello Viking explorers!

With this update, your progress is now saved. From now on, if you go out into battle while your village is unfinished, you'll find it as you left it when you return! You can leave and come back later without any worries.
In addition, we implemented some bug fixes and improvements to the controls, tutorials, and UI.

Thanks to your support, we are taking the game to new platforms. Dolmenjord - Viking Islands will be available soon on the Epic Games Store and Nintendo Switch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/8d2f976a82dc5088cb998c1ff139feabba686c80.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/628940c9327e5d3473818f3c026d7e5aaddd394c.png[/img]

Thanks for playing the game and for your feedback!
Follow the game page and our Steam developer´s page to keep track of our news:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

notes.title: Update - control improvements
notes.content:
In this update, we´ve made changes in the game controls using gamepad and keyboard, and in the camera movement.

We expect a smoother experience when:
- moving across the board to reposition an item - the camera will follow it, and the movement will be continuous when pressing a directional command.
- rotating the camera - the flag on the cursor points to the right indicating how the directional commands work.
- switching between the item's menu and the board.

Also, it fixes some minor bugs.

The option to remap the controls according to the players preference is not included in this version, but it is coming very soon!

Thank you for playing the game and for your feedback!
Follow the game page and our Steam developer´s page to keep track of our news:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
This update (v1.00.02):
- includes a new Option in the menu to disable Lightning and Thunder effects in the raining climate. Some people were uncomfortable with those effects.
- in the second interaction of the intro, where it is requested to rotate the island, now a lower angle is recognized to go ahead. The wide angle required didn´t make clear what was expected.
- fixes a problem where two levels were shown overlapped when quickly clicking Next more than once, or quickly clicking more than one level in the level selector.
- fixes a problem where, after asking if the player wanted a tip, the UI was not being shown if an item on the board was selected.
- improves the solution validation, making clearer the houses/walkway pieces that invalidates the solution. 

Thank you so much for playing the game and for providing your feedback. Most of the above items were requested or reported by our amazing players.
Keep posting your suggestions on the Community Hub.
